page.notes: Printed page is worn and the right column is partly obscured. Column pairing across the gutter is inferred from line alignment and is uncertain for several lines. Doubtful: "ordinum [?]" (last letters unclear), and the leading characters of "stæ cuiusmodi" and "culorum" in the right column.
